description: This file defines the HelpService class for managing help content retrieval, processing includes and variables, and caching help data in an Angular application.

classes.name: HelpData
classes.description: Interface representing help content data with content string and helpBaseUrl string.

methods.name: getHelpContent
methods.description: Retrieves help content for a given key, utilizing cache, loading from server if necessary, and processing includes and variables.

methods.name: loadHelpContent
methods.description: Loads help content data from server based on language and key, with fallback to default language.

methods.name: loadHelpContentFromBaseUrl
methods.description: Fetches help content markdown from a specific base URL, language, and key.

methods.name: processVariables
methods.description: Replaces variables in help content with actual values.

methods.name: processIncludes
methods.description: Processes include directives in help content recursively.
